mentions.name: Flotte
mentions.description: Flotte is an SSH access management solution for hobbyist and small to medium-sized businesses, aiming to provide fast just-in-time SSH certificate attestation. It focuses on making user on/offboarding fast, efficient login and sudo workflows without password lookups, mitigating private key leaks (especially in BYOD/BYOK environments), and helping admins manage server access quickly.
mentions.problem: SSH access management is cumbersome: on/offboarding users is slow, passwords must be looked up for logins and sudo, and private keys can leak, especially in BYOD/BYOK environments.
mentions.audience: Hobbyists and small to medium-sized businesses, with a focus on helping admins manage server access fast
mentions.source_excerpt:
Flotte, a ssh access management solution for hobbyist and small to medium-sized businesses.

We aim to provide a fast JIT ssh cert attestation.

With focus on:
* making on/offboard users fast
* efficient workflows (no need to lookup passwords for logins or sudo)
* mitigate private key leaks (especially in BYOD/BYOK environments) 
* Help admins manage server access fast
